verdicts.reason: A keeps a strong centred hierarchy: the headline wraps large on two lines, the pills are even and the CTA is prominent. However, the italic subtitle is jammed against 'Saturday 21 June', there is dead space beside the phone, and the placeholder image crowds the URL line next to the CTA. B has broken hierarchy: the headline sits off-axis to the right of the centred logo and is undersized. The date is smaller than the time line, the pill gaps are uneven, and the RSVP button is shrunk so its URL caption is larger than the button label. The legal line is also illegibly tiny.
